snippet.title: Truck Driver Gold Edition - Launch Trailer - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Get ready for the ultimate trucking adventure on Nintendo Switch with Truck Driver Gold Edition — launching October 23, 2025! This definitive edition brings the complete trucking experience, featuring the base game plus the acclaimed Heading North and Hidden Places & Damage System DLCs. Explore diverse scenic routes, from bustling cities to serene rural landscapes, while taking on exciting cargo missions and building your reputation as a legendary trucker.

Customize your truck with hundreds of parts and paint jobs inspired by the USA, UK, Germany, and France. Enjoy realistic weather, immersive day-night cycles, and authentic engine sounds. Whether you’re a simulation fan or new to the genre, this game offers a rich, open-world driving experience optimized for Nintendo Switch.
Subscribe and hit the notification bell for exclusive gameplay, tips, and updates on all things Truck Driver Gold Edition!
